UK Reviews Chagos Islands Deal Amid US Position

The United Kingdom is reviewing its deal concerning the Chagos Islands with Mauritius, according to British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting. He stated on Wednesday that the decision was made because the United States "does not support" the agreement. Annual payments to Mauritius, amounting to at least £120 million, have been placed on hold as the UK government reconsiders the deal, which relates to the Diego Garcia base.
